title: NGINX CVE-2026-8711 (CVSS 9.2) — Critical RCE in JavaScript Module (njs)

CVE-2026-42945.evidence: riables (`$http_*`, `$arg_*`, `$cookie_*`) alongside a location block invoking `ngx.fetch()`. Fixed in njs 0.9.9. This is distinct from the actively exploited NGINX Rift (CVE-2026-42945) which affects the `ngx_http_rewrite_module`. Security teams should audit `js_fetch_proxy`...
